data.name: Naser
data.gender_notes: Naser is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word ‘naṣr’, meaning ‘victory’ or ‘success’. In Islamic history, Naser is associated with the concept of helping and supporting others towards success. The name Naser carries the meaning “Victorious” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Naser usually hope their child will grow to embody victorious and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name filled with hope and motivation, representing the journey towards personal victory and success.
data.etymology: Naser belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Victorious.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Naser total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, Naser represents the belief in supporting and uplifting one another, just as Allah (God) has always supported the community of believers. The name echoes the Prophetic Hadith that advises, “The believer’s shade on the Day of Resurrection will be his charity.” Essentially, this name highlights the importance of providing aid and support to others, beside being a symbol for personal achievements and success.
